title: Course
description: One course. Materialises as a COVER row (CLASS_WEEK=0, BOOK_TYPE='COVER') in GT_CLASS_COURSE plus one MAIN row per lesson.

slug.description: Permanent identity. Must equal the directory name. Never reuse a retired slug.

curriculumType.description: GT_CLASS_COURSE.CURRICULUM_TYPE. Also forms le_tutor_curriculum.curriculum_type as PODO_{LANG}_{value}.

countryCode.description: GT_CLASS_COURSE.COUNTRY_CODE. Part of the natural key; use JP for courses shown to Japan-market learners.

classLevel.description: GT_CLASS_COURSE.CLASS_LEVEL. Quoted so 1.10 does not become 1.1. Grape truncates past 3 decimals.

thumbnail.description: Course-relative path to a PNG or JPEG. Sent with the decks; grape uploads it and writes the URL to BOOK_THUMBNAIL on the COVER row. Omit the key to leave whatever is already there — including a cover set by hand in grape admin.

localised.description: Serialised to a JSON column. ko is required because grape falls back to it for the admin list.
